props.name: children
props.description: The content of the popover.

props.name: id
props.description: DOM id for the popover element.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label for the popover.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of the element that labels the popover.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Id of the element that describes the popover.

props.name: placement
props.description: The position of the popover relative to the trigger.

props.name: size
props.description: Size variant of the popover.

props.name: class
props.description: Additional CSS class name.

props.name: styles
props.description: Spectrum-defined generated classes.

props.name: UNSAFE_className
props.description: Additional CSS class name. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: UNSAFE_style
props.description: Additional inline styles. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: hideArrow
props.description: Whether to hide the arrow pointing to the trigger.

props.name: padding
props.description: Custom padding inside the popover.

props.name: slot
props.description: A slot name for the component.

props.name: aria-details
props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that provide a detailed, extended description for the object.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Whether focus should move to the popover container on open.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The name of the component that triggered the popover.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the popover opens by default (uncontrolled).

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Whether the popover is open (controlled).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Handler called when the popover's open state changes.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: The max height of the popover.

props.name: triggerRef
props.description: The ref for the element which the popover positions itself with respect to. Required when used standalone (not within a trigger component).

props.name: containerPadding
props.description: The placement padding that should be applied between the element and its surrounding container.

props.name: offset
props.description: The additional offset applied along the main axis between the element and its anchor element.

props.name: crossOffset
props.description: The additional offset applied along the cross axis between the element and its anchor element.

props.name: shouldFlip
props.description: Whether the element should flip its orientation when there is insufficient room.

props.name: boundaryElement
props.description: A boundary element for placement calculations.

props.name: getTargetRect
props.description: Overrides the target element's bounding rectangle. Useful for positioning relative to a specific point such as the mouse cursor (e.g. context menus) or text selection.

props.name: arrowRef
props.description: A ref for the popover arrow element.

props.name: scrollRef
props.description: A ref for the scrollable popover element.

props.name: isNonModal
props.description: Whether the popover is non-modal (allows interaction outside).

props.name: isKeyboardDismissDisabled
props.description: Whether pressing Escape to close should be disabled.

props.name: shouldCloseOnInteractOutside
props.description: Filter for which outside interactions should close the popover.

props.name: isEntering
props.description: Whether the popover is entering (for animations).

props.name: isExiting
props.description: Whether the popover is exiting (for animations).

props.name: shouldSkipAnimation
props.description: Whether the popover should appear and disappear without an entry or exit animation. Used by PreviewTrigger to skip animations when quickly swapping between overlays.

props.name: children
props.description: Footer content, typically buttons.

props.name: class
props.description: Additional CSS class.

props.name: title
props.description: The title of the popover.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional description text.
